name: Equinix Istanbul Campus (IL1-IL4)
notes: Equinix entered Turkey in 2017 by acquiring Zenium's Istanbul campus (incl. Istanbul One, Turkey's first wholesale DC, built 2015 with IFC backing) for USD 93m. Campus (Umraniye/Asian side, Yukari Dudullu OSB) now comprises IL1-IL4; IL4 opened Nov 2024 with ~7.5 MW and 1,125 cabinets/~3,045 sqm white space, high-density/liquid-cooling capable. Combined campus reported near 12,000 sqm and ~22 MW IT load (industry sources).

name: Turk Telekom Istanbul Data Centers (Esenyurt & Gayrettepe)
notes: Turk Telekom operates data centers at Esenyurt (European side, multi-phase) and Gayrettepe (Istanbul Internet Data Center, referenced in a SEC 10-K exhibit for server hosting services) plus Ankara/Umitkoy. Official Esenyurt data center page confirms Tier III-grade colocation, cloud and managed services. Capacity MW not published.

name: Is Bankasi Atlas Data Center (Tuzla)
notes: Is Bankasi's flagship Atlas Data Center in Tuzla, Istanbul (~32,000 sqm) operating since 2018 and holding Tier IV Gold operational sustainability certification; operated via IT subsidiary IsNet with TS EN 50600 certification. Award-winning facility (Uptime/industry recognition per bank announcement). No public MW figure.

name: Vodafone Turkey Istanbul Data Center
notes: Vodafone Turkey operates data centers in Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir and Adana (5 facilities before the Edgnex JV), offering managed IT/colocation; Vodafone Business data center page confirms in-country hosting. Istanbul facility serves as a major node; capacity not published. Market analysis (Sep 2025) confirms footprint.

name: ENKA Data Solutions Tuzla Data Center
notes: ENKA Data Solutions (ENKA Group) operates a Tier III carrier-neutral data center in Tuzla, Istanbul offering colocation, GPU/AI infrastructure and high-availability services for Turkey and Europe; April 2025 event hosted at the Tuzla facility confirms operations. Capacity not disclosed.

name: NGN Star of Bosphorus Data Center (Istanbul)
notes: NGN (Star of Bosphorus brand), Istanbul-based carrier-neutral data center provider, operates its IST campus (Phase 1 listed in Data Center Catalog); DCE (Data Center Eurasia) references an NGN data center project manager, confirming ongoing operations/expansion. Capacity not published; catalog-grade evidence.

name: Telehouse Istanbul
notes: Telehouse Europe entered Istanbul via collaboration with Teknotel, operating a carrier-neutral data center (listed in Data Center Catalog); market analysis confirms Telehouse among international operators in Istanbul. Smaller-scale facility; capacity not published.

name: IGA Istanbul Airport Data Center (Phase 1)
notes: Data Center Catalog lists an IGA Data Center Phase-1 at Istanbul Airport; Turkcell job postings reference IP/data center network positions at iGA Istanbul Airport, suggesting telecom/data infrastructure on site. No operator or capacity officially confirmed; status unknown.

name: IBB Basaksehir Data Center
notes: Public-sector data center operated for Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality in Basaksehir, listed in Data Center Catalog. Serves municipal IT services; capacity not published.

name: KocSistem Camlica Data Center
notes: KocSistem (Koc Holding IT arm) data center at Camlica (Uskudar, Istanbul), listed in Data Center Catalog alongside its Ankara facility; provides hosting/cloud services. Capacity not published.

name: Mars Datacenter IST-1
notes: Mars Datacenter IST-1, an Istanbul colocation facility prepared to TS EN 50600 (Turkey's data center operations standard) with energy-efficiency-compliant hosting; listed in Data Center Catalog (Energy Star certified listing). Capacity not published.

name: Radore Data Center
notes: Radore, one of Turkey's leading retail colocation/hosting providers (Istanbul), operates a Tier III-standard data center with ~10,000 server capacity and 3,500+ customers; expanded with venture funding (2014, ~USD 8m). Capacity not published.

name: Pen Veri Merkezi (PenDC)
notes: Pen Veri Merkezi (PenDC), an Istanbul colocation provider with ~400 total racks and Novec 1230 fire suppression (Data Center Catalog); named among key Turkish DC operators in Arizton market analysis. Capacity not published.

name: Turkcell Izmir Data Center
notes: Turkcell Izmir Data Center inaugurated 22 June 2017 with Prime Minister Yildirim; first and only Tier III-certified data center in the Aegean region, ~17,600 sqm indoor area (LEED Gold candidate), supporting local data residency ('Turkey's data stays in Turkey'). No public MW figure; part of Turkcell's 8-DC network (41.5 MW total).

name: Vodafone-Edgnex (DAMAC) Izmir Data Center
developer: Edgnex Data Centres by DAMAC / Vodafone Turkey (50-50 JV)
notes: USD 100m 50/50 joint venture announced Feb 2024 for a Tier III data center in Izmir with initial 6 MW IT load, expandable to 12 MW; to bring Vodafone's Turkey DC count to six. Invest.gov.tr (official investment agency) coverage; Sept 2025 market analysis lists it as under construction with Q1 2025 opening target (opening may have slipped).

name: Vodafone Turkey Izmir Data Center (existing)
notes: Vodafone Turkey already operated a data center in Izmir (per Baxtel's note that the Edgnex JV facility is Vodafone's second in Izmir and sixth in Turkey). Data Center Map lists 10 data center facilities from 6 operators in Izmir, confirming an active colocation market. Capacity not published.

name: MERTELKOM Data Center (Mersin)
developer: Mersin Buyuksehir Belediyesi Imar Insaat A.S.
notes: MERTELKOM is a fully equipped data and technology center operated by Mersin Metropolitan Municipality's Imar Insaat A.S., described locally as one of the few facilities of this standard in the region, serving secure/sustainable municipal and regional data hosting with high-availability connectivity. Local press evidence; no MW capacity published.

name: Kayseri OSB Data Center
notes: Kayseri OSB announced a data center project at its September 2025 general assembly; IT directorate began infrastructure/software work and a capacity survey in October 2025. Facility will host industrial users' data locally (rental/hybrid model, 7/24 support) with target completion by end-2026. Local press/institution bulletin evidence; capacity not yet defined.
